LESSON: KUANDIKA 9.3.1 INSHA YA MAELEZO

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: MAGONJWA Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za Ujifunzaji Zi
Topic 9.3: Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha ya Maelezo

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha ya Maelezo. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua vifungu vya maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali
2. kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata mtindo na muundo ufaao

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua vifungu vya maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua vifungu vya maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata mtindo na muundo ufaao
   In simple words: practise until you can kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata mtindo na muundo ufaao. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha ya Maelezo using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha ya Maelezo in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha ya Maelezo to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha ya Maelezo.
4. Show that you can: kutambua vifungu vya maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha ya Maelezo using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha ya Maelezo important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua vifungu vya maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali
2. kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata mtindo na muundo ufaao

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
